content: पाशः [पश्यते बध्यतेऽनेन, पश्-करणे घञ्] .²1 A cord, chain, fetter, noose; पादाकृष्टव्रततिवलयासंगसंजातपाशः <ls>Ś. 1. 32</ls>; बाहुपाशेन व्यापादिता <ls>Mk. 9</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 84</ls>. .²2 A snare, trap or net for catching birds and beasts. .²3 A noose used as a weapon (as by Varuṇa); किं चायमरिदुर्वारः पाणौ पाशः प्रचेतसः <ls>Ku. 2. 21</ls>. .²4 A die, dice; <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>R. 6. 18</ls>. .²5 The edge or border of anything woven. .²6 (With Jainas) The outer world, nature. .²7 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) पाश expresses .³({%a%}) contempt or depreciation; as in छात्रपाशः a bad pupil; वैयाकरण˚, भिषक्˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) beauty or admiration; as in सैवोष्ठमुद्रा स च कर्णपाशः <ls>U. 6. 27</ls>; .³({%c%}) abundance, mass, or quantity (after a word signifying ‘hair’); as in केशपाश <ab>q. v.</ab> .{@-शी@} A rope, fetter; पाशीकल्पामायतामाचकर्ष <ls>Śi. 18. 57</ls>.
